findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A). 

On arrival the PIC was only able to provide two reporting agreements for the approximately 10 food handlers that work in the facility. Most of the remaining food handlers were present and signed blank copies during the inspection to correct. Ensure that all food handlers have been notified in a verifiable manner their responsibility to report foodborne illness related symptoms.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (E) After handling soiled EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

An employee was observed to move from washing dishes to donning gloves for food preparation. As the inspector was at the only hand sink in that area no hand washing took place during this procedure. Education was conducted with the PIC and they are instructed to review hand washing with the food handlers in the facility. Ensure hand washing takes place at all times that it is required in the facility.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

The bar hand sink was without a hand drying system at the time of this inspection. The paper towels that are normally at this location were found and brought back to their location to correct. Ensure that the hand sinks are properly supplied at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.citation_text:
3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables.

A log of raw sausage is observed over ready-to-eat pickles in one of the refrigerators. The PIC was shown and education conducted. The sausage was moved to under these items to correct. Ensure foods are stored in the refrigerators according to their cooking order at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

On arrival the sanitizer in the three part sink was observed at approximately 100 ppm quat. Effective ranges for quat sanitizer are 200 ppm - 400 ppm. The PIC was shown and education conducted. The sink was brought up to effective concentration during the inspection to correct the violation. Ensure that all sanitizers are maintained at effective concentrations at all times int he facility.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: Inspector observed the soda gun near the beer taps to be soiled with mold. The soda gun was cleaned and sanitized immediately. Violation was corrected on site. Maintain soda guns clean and sanitized. 

(A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
4-903.11: Inspector observed a container of clean utensils stored next to the hand sink so that the clean items are exposed to splash. Remove the clean items to a protected spot or remove items from the facility that are no longer needed. Correct the violation by the next routine inspection. 

(A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that allows air drying, covered or inverted. (D) Items that are kept in closed PACKAGES may be stored below 6 inches if on dollies, pallets, racks, and skids properly designed.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-904.11: Inspector observed unwrapped/unprotected single use straws stored on the bar top. Also, a box of single use cups is observed on the floor. The straws were moved to the back bar and the single use cups were placed on the back of the single door coffin cooler. The violation is considered corrected on site. Maintain the single use items clean and protected. 

(A) cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed to prevent FOOD- and lip-contact surface contamination. (B) UTENSILS not prewrapped shall be presented so only handles are touched by EMPLOYEES and/or CONSUMERS. (C) SINGLE-SERVCIE ARTICLES intended for FOOD- and lip-contact shall be furnished for CONSUMER with wrapper or APPROVED dispenser.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: Inspector observed the soda gun holder by the beer taps to be soiled. The soda gun holder was cleaned at time of inspection. The violation was corrected on site. Maintain the holder clean. 

NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.114: Inspector observed items for food service in the facility including but not be limited to a hot dog roller, pizza cutter and pizza oven. Remove items that are not necessary for the operation of the facility as a low risk. 

The PREMISES shall be free of: (A) Items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment such as EQUIPMENT that is nonfunctional or no longer used; and (B) Litter

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: Inspector observed the fan covers of the walk in cooler and the ceiling of the walk in cooler to be soiled. Clean and maintain these areas clean. 

(A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

Observed the bar hand sink to have beverages dumped into it with a utensil blocking the sink. Discussed with PIC. Dumping appears to have occurred last night (dried beverage stains). Ensure staff is aware hand washing sink is for hand washing ONLY. Utilize the 3 compartment sink to dump liquids or another dump sink. COS.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

(REPEAT) Observed no quaternary ammonium test strips. Discussed with PIC. Facility utilizes the sanitizer tablets. Ensure extra test strips are available at the facility. Repeat violation since the 7/29/21 inspection. Inspector will follow-up on 12/19/22.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time.

Observed extremely molded can of nacho cheese sauce within refrigerator. Discarded cheese sauce. Ensure date marking (7 days) and disposition of expired/molded foods. COS.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
2-102.11: Based on the RISKS inherent to the FOOD operation, PIC shall demonstrate knowledge by:  (A) Having no Priority Foundation items; (B) Being a CFM; OR (C) Responding correctly questions as they relate to the specific FOOD operation. The areas of knowledge include C1 through C16.  

Observed the PIC unable to answer any questions related to food handling. PIC was not a CFPM or a food handler. PIC was unable to answer paperwork questions, general food handling questions, and physical facilities questions. Ensure PIC and staff are aware of safe food handling practices, paperwork related to public health, and can answer questions related to these subjects. Enroll staff as needed in food handler’s classes and/or CFPM’s classes. A CFPM must be present during all hours of operation. Create a public health binder or folder that contains all the necessary paperwork needed during inspections. Inspector will follow-up on 8/9/21.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. 

(REPEAT) Observed PIC to lack a CFPM’s license. Upon questioning, PIC is able to make pizza’s downstairs. A CFPM must be present during all hours of food operation. Discussed with PIC. Ensure enough CFPM’s are available during all operational hours. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 10/9/19.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC. 

Observed facility to lack signed employee health reporting agreements. Provided copy for facility. Ensure all staff that handles food (including bar staff who makes drinks with ice and sliced fruits) reads and understands document, then signs. Inspector will follow-up on 8/9/21.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment:
2-501.11: A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. Reference 2-501.11.  

Observed no Norovirus illness clean-up policy at facility. Provided copy. Ensure facility has bleach to perform procedure. Inspector will follow-up on 8/9/21.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

(REPEAT) Observed the following food-contact surfaces to be in need of cleaning:
1. Ice machine baffle has accumulation of slime and mold - wash, rinse, sanitize. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 10/9/19.
2. Both soda nozzles at the bar had accumulation of debris within the soda nozzle, as well as the soda nozzle holder - wash, rinse, sanitize.
3. Interior of basement refrigerator (that was cold holding cheese sauces, sliced cheese, shred cheese, taco filling) is dirty and in need of wash, rinse, sanitizing.
4. Microwaves in the basement and outside are both soiled - wash, rinse, sanitize.

Ensure routine cleaning of food-contact surfaces - wash, rinse, sanitize. Inspector will follow-up regarding all these areas on 8/9/21.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. 

Observed the basement refrigerator not keeping temperature. Items probed were out of temperature: sliced cheese (50 degrees F), taco filling (49 degrees F). Items tested with infrared thermometer gun: sour cream (52 degrees F), shred cheese (54 degrees F). Items were voluntarily discarded. Temperature of this cooler was turned down (was set at 1, turned to 4 - 5 setting is coldest). Inspector will follow-up on 8/2/21.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device. (C) Does not apply to EQUIPMENT without practical means of measuring ambient air surroundings. (D) TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be designed to be easily readable. C (E) FOOD and water TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall have numerical scale, printed record, or digital readout in increments no greater than 1C or 2F in the intended range of use. Pf

Observed no thermometer within the refrigerator downstairs. Discussed with PIC. Purchase thermometer and place in cooler.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

Observed no quaternary ammonium test strips at the facility. PIC was unable to tell Inspector if facility has test strips. Sanitization tested correctly with Inspector’s test strips. Purchase test strips. Inspector will follow-up on 8/9/21.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

Observed flooring near basement hand sink (by laundry) to have knicks and pieces missing. Seal to make smooth and easily cleanable.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. 

Observed entire bar flooring area to be very sticky. Inspection occurred in mid-afternoon. Facility opens near lunch time. Ensure routine nightly cleaning - mop floors.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.  

(REPEAT) Observed no food handlers licenses present during inspection. PIC was not a food handler or a CFPM. Discussed with PIC. PIC indicated she had worked for facility over 30 days and therefore should already have a food handlers license. Ensure all staff (including bar staff that handle ice and sliced fruits) have a food handlers license. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 10/9/19.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: Handsink in the basement has unsealed surfaces around it - see that Nudo or similar wallboard is installed around the sink to make surfaces smooth and easily cleanable.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text:
750.540 (C) The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training. Reference 750.540.
Certified food manager must be present any time pizzas are being made or served.

findings.title: No bare hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed
findings.citation_text: 3-301.11 (P) Observed food employee used bare hands to handle ready to eat foods (Cut lemons for drinks) . Food employees shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas/tongs, dispensing equipment or single use gloves when handling ready to eat foods. Reference 3-301.11.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Observed ice machine baffle food contact surface to be soiled with slime mold. Wash, rinse, sanitize food-contact surfaces routinely. Reference 4-601.11(A).

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.citation_text: 7-102.11  (Pf) Observed working container of sanitizer at outdoor bar not properly labeled. Containers of toxic materials must be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material. Person in charge labeled the container. Reference 7-102.11.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

Except as specified in Section 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are smooth and easily cleanable.  Reference 6-201.11.

Observed no full time manager for the establishment. Provide a food manager.

findings.comment:

750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
1). Observed a bag of chicken breast in the mini cooler in the kitchen with no date mark and a reading of 51F with a recently calibrated probe thermometer. The chicken was discarded during the inspection. 2). Observed a open container of banana peppers sitting on the top shelf in the kitchen. The commercial container stated refrigerate after opening. The banana peppers were discarded during the inspection.3) Observed pizza sauce with a date mark of 4/14. The pizza sauce was discarded during the inspection.
750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed a open black container on the counter filled with parsley flakes unprotected. Protect food at all times.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the handle to the beer cooler appears to be broken and repaired with duct tape. Repair beer cooler handle.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean

750-1120 Each lavatory shall be provided with hot and cold water tempered by means of a mixing valve or combination faucet.

750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
1) (REPEAT) Observed multiple pieces of trim around the nudo board in the kitchen to be pulling away, warped or missing. Repair trim pieces. 2) (REPEAT) Wall behind cookline equipment is soiled with grease. Clean the wall.  3) Women's restroom sink is unattached from the wall. Re-caulk the sink to the wall.
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment:
Observed toxic chemicals to be stored above single service items.  The employee on duty moved the single service items.
750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Approved source
findings.comment: Observed multiple food items that have been cooked and cooled. This practice is not within the conditions of facilities permit. Cooling and reheating under a medium permit is not allowed. Items were discarded to correct the violation. 750-100 Facility must operate under the conditions of their permit.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed a container of pizza sauce date marked 9/30. All potentially hazardous, ready to eat foods must be date marked and used or discarded by the end of day 7. Item was discarded to correct the violation.
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the chest freezer in the basement to have a damaged lid and gasket. Remove tape and repair or replace lid to make sure it is tight fitting and smooth and easily cleanable.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed multiple soiled wiping cloths hung on handle for oven and used as a plug for drip catch at the grill. Store wiping cloths in sanitizer bucket at proper concentration between uses. Do not use cloth to stop drip catch on grill.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the ice deflector in the mop sink room to be soiled with what appears to be mold. Remove ice and wash, rinse, and sanitizer all food (ice) contact surfaces.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed exterior surfaces of cookline equipment to be heavily soiled with an accumulation of grease, char, and food debris. 2) interior surface of microwave is soiled with food debris. 3) stand on which the cook line equipment is stored is heavily soiled with an accumulation of grease, char, and food debris. Clean these non-food contact surfaces. Cook line area is in need of a detailed cleaning.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Floor below cook line is soiled with an accumulation of grease and food debris.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed multiple pieces of trim around the nudo board in the kitchen to be pulling away, warped, or missing. Repair trim pieces to make for a smooth and easily cleanable surface. 2) Wall behind cook line equipment is soiled with grease. Clean the wall.
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: Thermometers missing in the following cooling items: 1) Chest freezer in basement, standing freezer in basement, freezer/refrigerator in basement, kitchen refrigerator/freezer unit.  Provide thermometers in these units.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
The following items are soiled or in disrepair: 1) Exposed wood surface on door jam in mop sink room. Paint or seal wood to make easily cleanable. 2) Exposed wood around cut out piece in men's restroom stall. Caulk gap. 3) Duct tape on bar cooler handle. Duct tape is NOT an easily cleanable surface, remove tape. 4) Chest freezer in basement has large amount of ice accumulation. Defrost chest freezer. 5) Soiled hood system and one hood filter missing.  Clean hood and replace filter.
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable
750-700 Ventilation hoods shall be designed for easy cleaning and designed to prevent the cross contamination of food and food-contact surfaces by dripping grease or condensation.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Mold in ice machine. Clean ice machine.
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The following items are soiled: 1) Slime mold coming out of pipe into mop sink from ice machine. Clean ice machine and flush pipe. 2) Top of ice machine is soiled. Clean it.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed faucet of hand sink at bar has a leak. Repair leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Containers covered, adequate number, insect and rodent proof, emptied at proper intervals, clean
findings.comment:
Observed dumpster lid to be open. Keep lid closed when not filling.
750-1130a Garbage and refuse shall be kept in durable easily cleanable, insect-proof, and rodent-proof containers.

findings.title: Outside storage area clean, enclosure properly constructed
findings.comment:
Trash on ground outside of dumpster. Clean up trash and make sure all trash goes into dumpster.
750-1140c Outside storage areas shall be large enough to store the outside garbage and refuse containers and shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
Open window for fan in mop sink room. Screen in window to prevent insects from entering.  Fan kicked on before inspectors left, but it needs to be screened as a permanent solution.  We will spot check this in a week.
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The following floors are soiled: 1) Kitchen floor is soiled under fryer, 3-part sink, pizza oven. Clean floors. 2) Soiled floor in basement freezer/refrigerator room. Clean floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
Observed hole in light shield in basement freezer room. Replace shield.
750-1240 All lights in the food prep, food storage or kitchen area of a establishment must be properly shielded (i.e. either have a physical shield or be a shatter resistant bulb) so as to reduce the potential for cross contamination in case of breakage.  Provide properly shielded lights.

Wet mop stored in mop bucket.  Hang mops to dry.
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similiar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
750.1210a  The following walls and ceilings are inadequate:  (A) There is a gap around the wall to celing juncture in the ice machine room (REPEAT VIOLATION FROM THE PRE-OPENING INSPECTION), (B) There is a gap around the door frame inside the ice machine room (REPEAT VIOLATION FROM THE PRE-OPENING INSPECTION), (C) there were missing ceiling tiles in the basement room with the freezers and refrigerators, (D) the 3-compartment sink needs to be recaulked to the wall on the right side of the sink.  Seal all gaps  at thewall to ceiling juncture.  Replace the trim or seal the gap around the door frame.  The missing ceiling tiles were put back in the room in the basement and the 3-compartment sink was caulked to the wall to correct.
750.1220a  There is a foam mounting material on the wall of the women's restroom under the towel dispenser.  Clean the material off the wall.
